main_idea: A simple prompt cuts clutter from up to 61% to near 0%
ideas: Raw prompt scores range widely by model
Simple prompt scores near zero for all models
summary: Clutter-free, but the bars, values and model labels are misaligned, so a reader cannot match each bar to its model.
defects: Model name labels sit between rows, not beside their bars
Bars and value labels are offset from their axis rows
The 61% bar sits in the row labelled Claude Sonnet 5.5
Value 46% and 42% bars overlap vertically and crowd together
Axis shows 0 to 80 numbers next to percent row labels, mixing scales
Bar-to-model mapping is unreadable, so the chart cannot be trusted
